entities.text: Syed Sadruddin vs State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner- Accused No.3 to quash the proceedings against him in FIR No.30 of 2021 pending on the file of Station House Officer, Mahabubnagar I Town Police Station,
Mahabubnagar, filed for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468 and 472 read with 120 of Indian Penal Code (for short "IPC").
2.

entities.text:
Mahabubnagar I Town Police Station,
Mahabubnagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner - Accused and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent - State.
3. The crime was registered in February, 2021 on the basis of complaint of 2nd and 3rd respondents - de facto complainants.
4. The complaint is the outcome of sale transactions which are subject matter of civil disputes.

5. Considering the civil disputes between the parties, this Court by order dated 27.04.2022 in Criminal Petition No.3399 of 2021 had directed the Investigating Officer not to arrest the petitioner - accused No.6 till completion of investigation and filing of final report, in the present crime.

6. Since civil disputes are involved and transactions pertain to sale of property, this Court deems it appropriate to extend the benefit granted to accused No.6 earlier, to this petitioner - accused No.3 also.

7. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of directing the Investigating Officer in respect of FIR No.30 of 2021 pending on the file of Station House Officer, Mahabubnagar I Town Police Station, Mahabubnagar, to conclude investigation without taking any coercive steps against the petitioner - accused No.3.

entities.text: Mahabubnagar I Town Police Station, Mahabubnagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Further, the petitioner - Accused No.3 shall appear before the concerned Police and execute a personal bond for Rs.1,00,000/- and co- operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required for the purpose of investigation.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.

K.SURENDER, J Date: 21.02.2023 rev Syed Sadruddin vs State Of Telangana, on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96906298/
